name: nuvio-serverless-discovery
description: Cloudflare Worker serving Nuvio /.well-known/nuvio backend discovery for serverless Supabase Cloud deployments.

SUPABASE_URL.description: Your Supabase project URL (e.g. https://<project-ref>.supabase.co) from Supabase Dashboard -> Project Settings -> Data API.

SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.description: Your Supabase public client key (sb_publishable_... or anon JWT) from Supabase Dashboard -> Project Settings -> API Keys. Never use a service_role or secret key.

TV_LOGIN_ENABLED.description: Set to "true" to advertise TV login support in discovery capabilities, or "false" to disable it.

WATCH_PARTY_ENABLED.description: Optional experimental capability flag ("false" by default).
